definition: Unsigned exact Euclidean distance to zero-valued pixel centers. Signed exact Euclidean distance to all linearly interpolated horizontal/vertical threshold crossings plus exact-zero pixel centers, with sign of input minus threshold.
site_id: Horizontal edge: source linear pixel ID; vertical edge: pixels+source ID; exact-zero pixel:2*pixels+source ID. Unsigned site ID=source pixel ID. Equal squared distance selects minimum site ID.
Voronoi: Absolute short2=floor(subpixel site x,y); relative short2=query pixel minus anchor; no-site sentinel -32768 in both pairs.

floating_distance.NaN: reject input before any output writes

comparison.native: Full outputs and mathematical/algorithm differences recorded; no vendor-equality or hidden fitted tolerance

implementation: HIP unsigned row/column integer-site search; signed compacted GPU site set and direct all-site search with global squared-cost then site-ID ties. CPU file/metadata/scalar only.

oracle.algorithm: SciPy cKDTree of independent explicit subpixel sites, with exact squared-distance recomputation and deterministic tie selection
